name: jellyfin.avado.dnp.dappnode.eth
title: Jellyfin (films and music)
shortDescription: Your own streaming service for your films, series and music
description: Your own streaming service: Jellyfin plays the films, series, music and photos you keep on your AVADO, on your TV, phone, tablet or computer, with no subscription and no tracking. Getting started: open Jellyfin, pick your language, create your user name and password, and add a library that points to the folder /media. Then install the free Jellyfin app on your TV or phone and use the server address https://jellyfin.my.ava.do. Any device that can open my.ava.do (at home on the AVADO network, or away through Remote Access) can watch. Converting videos for a phone uses a lot of processor time; your AVADO gives the Ethereum node priority, so playback may pause briefly while the node is busy.
author: AVADO
